programmes.d: Roommate pilots Devan and Scott experience a mysterious rise in oil pressure that could destroy one of the C-46's engines.
Mikey goes on a Venezuelan treasure hunt for a rare CL-215 waterbomber, and new pilots Andrew and Graeme face their toughest test yet - flying with irascible boss Joe McBryan.

Buffalo launches an all-out campaign to airlift 100,000lbs of essential goods to cut-off northern communities, Justin helps a Mountie move and expectant parents Rod and Sasha show off their 3D ultrasound.
Crusty mechanic Chuck scrambles to ready the Electra for a mission to the High Arctic, and former rampie Audrey returns to Buffalo and reignites the battle of the sexes.
A multi-stop mission to the Far North pits Devan, Scott and Adam in an ongoing battle for fuel and oil as they circuit their destinations.

Young pilots AJ and Andrew get the chance of a lifetime to fly the DC-3 mounted on snow skis, and tension mounts across the company as Buffalo’s Mackenzie Valley food mail delivery contract is up for renewal.
Buffalo flies the Stanley Cup on a tour of the North, and a licence suspension has Joe looking for a captain to replace him on the passenger run he’s flown for almost 30 years.
Chief pilot Arnie lands the DC-3 on a homemade sand strip at a remote lodge. Electra expert Chuck faces off with a stubborn power unit, and Rod's wife Sasha goes into labour.
When thunderstorms and a shaky engine threaten a charter to Whitehorse, Joe pulls out all the stops to get the passengers to their destination.
A potential Electra plane purchase in Coventry, England has Joe showing Mikey the ropes of international business.
While training pilots for the upcoming fire season, chief pilot Arnie makes an unexpected announcement.
A giant, but simple chair provides some oversized complications for Jarrett when it won't fit down the stairs.
Jessica Samko wins a bizarre carnival type attraction, but things go fowl, when she lands a side load of baby swans.
Samko reluctantly teams up with Jenn after Jenn bids way above her weight class.
Dusty's sensitive side is called on when he nets the job of transporting hundreds of live butterflies.
Marc is at the helm of relaunching a massive homemade houseboat but the family's history with the boat, and Marc's stormy attitude, threaten to sink the job before it ever reaches water
After winning a black light putt-putt golf course, Jenn's game is tested when she realizes that for her run, "MINI-golf" is a misnomer.
Jenn won't save the world, but she better make her deadline when she hauls a 16-foot-tall Power Ranger to a child's birthday party.
Jarrett learns the answer to the question, "Where does the world's largest hog sit?" (anywhere it wants), while hauling a shipment of epic proportions.
While shipping an 11-foot-tall glass water pipe to the Mile-High City, Marc tries to mellow out after a blown tire threatens to turn this shipment into shards.
When tasked with hauling the old animatronic band, Rock-A-Fire Explosion, Jenn ends up pulling a Yoko Ono and almost cancels their reunion tour.
After the delivery of sad family news, Jenn turns to Jarrett to take over an odd shipment.
Todd and Tamera struggle to fly straight after they discover their giant Robin Hood statue load is broken and Samko is bent to her limits when her load of trees is doubled.
"Cowgirl" Jennifer must call Roy in for help with some wild bucking bulls. Chris and Robbie bust their trailer with an overweight houseboat.

Region 7 wardens converge upon the Intake fishing access site on the Yellowstone River as the annual paddlefish migration is in full swing. Watch anglers snag paddlefish and Wardens snag illegal anglers!

The Tongue River Reservoir State Park in south-central Montana is a popular summer destination for recreationists and fishermen, and Warden Mike Krings has his hands full keeping peace among the night crowd.

Wardens in Region 5 work their way up the Yellowstone River with a jet boat checking fly fishing outfitters while coming across a boat accident along the way. Then it's over to Region 1 for firearms training.

With Pronghorn antelope populations dwindling, Wardens of Region 7 run a decoy sting the day before the season begins but the real problem arises with trespassing on the opener. Then Region 4 Warden Bryan Golie has a potential poaching call.

The Upper Missouri River is a blue-ribbon trout fishery & popular rafting destination. The Cascade district in Region 4 has its share of excitement with the mysterious camper parked on private land. Then over to Region 7 for some water safety checks.

Region 2 wardens are responding to a Tip Mont call with multiple elk down in grizzly country. Upon arrival, one elk & the suspect are missing. In the meantime, wardens in Region 7 have shots fired during a decoy sting.

When your job is protecting our most precious natural resources in some of the nation's most remote areas, there is rarely a dull moment. Wardens chronicles the lives of Conservation Officers in America.

In the shadows of the crazy mountains, the Yellowstone River becomes a rainbow of color during the annual boat float weekend. With jet boats, the Wardens are prepared for a crazy weekend of protecting the river and assisting the crazed rafters.
This week our Wardens receive a Tip-Mont call about a few illegally taken elk and pursue the the suspects.
This week our Wardens are in Montana monitoring the rivers while people paddlefish and we also try and eliminate a pesky bear from one man's property.
This week the Wardens set up a game checkpoint to make sure everyone is following the rules.

Montana Game Wardens set up an operation targeting illegal off-road vehicle usage. We also follow a patrol along the Missouri River, making sure the boaters are safe and legal.
Montana Game Wardens look into illegally taken antlers. Plus, follow along as they help with conservation efforts for sage grouse and walleye

Joe hires an outsider to whip Buffalo into shape – starting with Mikey. Gord and Sean’s DC-3 delivery to the High Arctic goes awry when blizzard conditions and a broken oil cooler force an emergency landing.

Buffalo gets into the stunt flying business, re-enacting a famous WWII bombing raid with a DC-4. A hole in the C-46’s exhaust system forces Devan to decide whether or not to shut down an engine mid-flight.
